selection: Complete used factual county participation, governor and both House tables: all candidate, method and reporting-unit counts and four source receipts. Governor units establish the current House partition, not a historical crosswalk. No source HTML, newly acquired workbook, unrelated contest or personal data.
native_verification: Before selection, independent offline HTMLParser extraction checked all four frozen originals, 110 unit rows and 385 unit-candidate cells. This package reproduces selected facts, not a new native acquisition.
source_precedence: The November 6 observation is separate from the preserved older official package. Never combine older participation with these candidate vectors. Provider district major-party vectors must agree before county replacement; official write-ins replace the provider's omitted other votes.
literal_party: Write-in has a blank native HTML party. It is not the older workbook's Nonpartisan label. No party is inferred.

literal_name_alias.basis: The older frozen official package also names BRESNAHAN JR, ROB. Only this literal suffix difference was reviewed; no general name waiver.

limitations: UNOFFICIAL snapshot; source update timezone is not supplied.
Registered voters are a changing administrative denominator, not VEP or a fixed cohort.
Candidate totals are not ballots. Source-reported units do not establish final completeness.
No new map approval, historical precinct identity, individual switching or staying-home estimate.
Provider state/district tables remain separate, not composite county sums.
reproduction: Run python3 test-review-monroe-house-selection.py, then python3 review-monroe-house-selection.py --source selected-source-facts.json --output NEW_DIRECTORY. Compare every checksummed member. No network required.
